title: Structural Design Engineer
jobDescription:
Broad Responsibilities Required minimum 2 yrs of Experience
- Designing structures such as buildings, and industrial Structures based on specifications, safety standards, and functional
- requirements.
- Performing structural analysis to calculate loads, stress, and material strength. This includes considering dynamic loads, seismic
- forces, wind pressures, and other environmental factors.
- Working closely with architects, civil engineers, contractors, and other specialists to ensure structural designs align with the
- overall project vision.
- Communicating with clients to understand their requirements and providing technical explanations for design choices and changes.
- Modelling in analysis software, analysis, design of structures
- Design documentation
- Drawing checking, coordination and finalizing
- Coordination with client and internal team
- Guiding subordinates

title: Tekla Precast Modeller / Detailer
requiredSkills: AutoCAD Would be the Added Advantage
Work closely with team and understand the project need
jobDescription:
Broad Responsibilities
- A Tekla Precast Modeller is responsible for creating detailed 3D models, GA Drawings, Erection Drawings, and Shop Drawings of precast structures using Tekla software.
- Develop accurate 3D models, including rebar modelling, for precast structures.
- Generate detailed construction and production drawings, such as plans, elevations, sections, and reinforcement details.
- Prepare precast erection drawings, production drawings, hardware drawings, and material lists.
- Review project documents to identify conflicts, missing dimensions, and insufficient information.
- Coordinate with team members and ensure deliverables meet deadlines and quality standards.
- Conduct quality control and assurance checks on drawings and models.

jobDescription:

title: Steel Detailer (AutoCAD / CAD)
requiredSkills: Work closely with drafting team and understand the project need
jobDescription:
Broad Responsibilities
- Use CAD software to create detailed drawings.
- Responsibilities Expertise in Steel structural detailing using Auto CAD for industrial projects, such as warehouses, Industrial Plants, factories, PEB.
- Prepare detailed steel drawing, plan, elevations, typical connections.
- Ensure fundamental knowledge of drawing a fasasd fixing, gutter fixing, roof sheeting, and MEP equipment arrangements.
